about: The one lifecycle every Nessa Docs page and task follows. The validator, the reader and the nessa-docs skill all read this file. A project may add requirements to an event in docs/state/nessa-docs.yaml (work.require); it can never add, remove or rename a state or an event.

states.planned: The chart and its tasks are accepted. Nobody is on it yet.
states.blocked: Waiting on an answer. Always carries the question.
states.review: Built. A PR or diff is waiting for review.
states.implemented: Merged, and the page is stamped with sourceRevision.
states.verified: Implemented, and its rules held at that same commit (modelCheck). Only for pages with a model.

shown.stale: Implemented or verified, but a source file changed after the page's sourceRevision. Worked out by the reader, never written.

needs.question: The record's body asks the question, with the options and a recommendation.
needs.evidence: At least one evidence entry: a pr, commit, check or diff.
needs.commit: An evidence entry naming the full commit id that landed it.
needs.pr: An evidence entry naming the pull request.
needs.check: An evidence entry naming a passing check.
needs.modelCheck: The page has a model whose saved check is fresh, broke nothing, left nothing unchecked, and names the same commit as the page's sourceRevision.
